topics.label: Introduction and course learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the course structure, themes, and key learning outcomes for understanding cancer biology.

topics.label: Biological foundations and experimental modeling of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how genetic and epigenetic changes disrupt normal cell differentiation and tissue architecture, and explain the experimental methods used to model these processes in culture.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and pathological distinction of tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the histological and physical characteristics that distinguish benign growths from invasive, metastatic malignancies.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and benign lesion risks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate the stepwise progression from benign precursors to invasive cancer using colorectal models and discuss the clinical complications posed by benign tumors.

topics.label: Tumor classification and nomenclature conventions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the standard naming rules and exceptions used to categorize benign and malignant tumors according to their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer-induced morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanical, local, and systemic pathophysiological mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause patient morbidity and death.

topics.label: Comparative oncology and cancer incidence across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine cancer frequency and distribution patterns across human populations, domestic animals, and diverse multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical detection and cancer screening programs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the principles, clinical benefits, and diagnostic challenges of population-level screening programs across various cancer types.

topics.label: Closing remarks and practical preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with a recap of the learning outcomes and reminders for upcoming practical classes.
